column1: # Why each requirement without a verification activity is a gap (OR-12): ID<TAB>reason. A reason
# never maps an ID; docs/verification.md lists the ID under Gaps with it.

column2: Only Chrome is driven by the e2e suite (playwright.config.ts); Firefox, Edge, Safari and mobile browsers are not tested
Development runs a local media volume and Mailpit, not external object storage or an email service (TBD-1); one deployment is not yet chosen (TBD-2)
No Bidder Guide is written; the help pages (frontend/src/help) cover the four UD-4 topics only
An assumption about who sells; nothing in the system to verify
An assumption that delivery is outside the platform; nothing in the system to verify
An assumption of one auction format; no single activity cites it, though every bidding test is for that format
Images are stored on a local volume and email goes to Mailpit; the external services are not chosen (TBD-1)
The room shows each of these, but no test cites UI-3 or checks the list as one
A statement that there is no special hardware; no activity cites it
Uploads use the standard file control (e2e/sell.spec.ts), but HTTPS is a deployment matter (TBD-2) and camera capture is not tested
The OpenAPI schema is generated by FastAPI, but the client's types are written by hand (frontend/src/lib/contract.ts), not derived from it
TLS is a deployment matter (TBD-2): the development stack serves plain HTTP on localhost
The message types are in backend/app/schemas/ws.py and the server's events (price update is bid_placed), but no test cites CI-5
TLS and strict transport security are a deployment matter (TBD-2)
Postgres and Redis have no public port (docker-compose.override.yml binds 127.0.0.1 only), but Redis requires no authentication
No test stores and reads back non-ASCII names, titles or descriptions

No test asserts all three effects of one acceptance together (new highest bid and bidder, the sequence increment, the soft close); test_concurrency.py shows highest and sequence move as one, test_soft_close.py that the same call extends. Until 2026-10-19 the matrix counted the helper proxy_model.py (audit M12)
